author: j. r. johnson
title: Rebecca Dow urges continued civic engagement in recent social media posts
text:
Representative Rebecca Dow, a Republican member of the New Mexico State House for the 38th district, has posted a series of messages on her social media account encouraging civic engagement and ongoing political involvement.
On February 18, 2026, Dow wrote, “It’s not over until it’s over”.
Later that day, she urged continued public participation by stating, “Please keep calling, emailing, and texting lawmakers. YOUR engagement matters!”
In another post from February 18, Dow addressed her constituents directly: “Dear New Mexicans- YOU DID THIS! Imagine what will happen if you plan to engage in this year’s elections??? @newsguy44 @IWF”
Dow was elected to the New Mexico State House in 2025 to represent the state’s 38th House district, succeeding Tara Jaramillo. She is known for advocating active citizen involvement in legislative processes and regularly uses social media platforms to communicate with her constituents.
